```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

joined <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet") |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    days_to_resolution = as.Date(substr(resolved_at, 1, 10)) - date,
    time_bucket = factor(
      case_when(
        days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
        days_to_resolution >= 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
        days_to_resolution >= 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
        days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1 to 7 days",
        days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      )
    )
  )

groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prediction_error = mean(abs(probability - outcome_numeric), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(accuracy)

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_prediction_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time until resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
final_day <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

ggplot(final_day, aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}
calibration <- final_day |>
  mutate(probability_bin = cut(
    probability,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = as.numeric(probability_bin) / 10 - 0.05, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts are closest to calibrated at the extremes",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES resolution rate",
    size = "Markets"
  )
```
